name: @zframes/plugins
description: The built-in provider-plugin registry: the manifests of the first-party plugins an installation can mount (Node half, pure data — feeds `zframes providers`, the derived proxy allowlist and the providers route) and the loader that dynamic-imports a mounted plugin's code in the browser as its own chunk. A third-party plugin can't exist until the contract ships on npm, so this registry covers everything loadable today.
author: Zentry
